assets.generationPrompt: Create an original identity-neutral pixel-art style calibration object, not a recognizable animal, mascot, franchise character, or artist imitation. The object is one featureless asymmetrical bean-shaped volume resting on two tiny block feet, with no face, ears, tail, clothing, symbol, or story detail. Render it on a 64x64 transparent canvas using a 32x32 logical grid, at most 16 warm colors, one-logical-pixel dark chromatic outline rather than pure black, rounded two-to-four-pixel clusters, and two-step lighting from upper left. Use a coral main fill, cream light plane, teal accent plane, and muted plum shadow solely to demonstrate palette relationships. Center the object and align both feet to one floor line. No anti-aliasing, blur, gradient, dithering, texture, external shadow, ground, frame, text, logo, watermark, duplicate object, or semi-transparent edge. Return only one RGBA PNG.
